usdcxFaucetUnavailable: The USDCx faucet is not known yet. Reopen review to try again.

transactionNotConfirmedHint: The wallet could not confirm whether this went through. It may still complete, so check the wallet after it syncs before you try again.

noteDeliveryRecoveryHint: Keep this wallet open and connected - delivery is retried automatically for up to three days, and this warning clears once it goes through. If the recipient still has nothing after a day, do not send again; save the transaction ID below and contact support, since the transfer can still be recovered from it.
noteDeliveryRetriesStoppedHint: Automatic delivery has stopped for this transfer. Do not send again; save the transaction ID below and contact support, since the transfer can still be recovered from it.

privateKeyRevealAcknowledge: I understand this key cannot be rotated or revoked.

fastTransactionDescription: The transaction will automatically be broadcasted and finalized.
generatingTransactionDescription: This may take a moment depending on network traffic. You can close this — we'll notify you when it's done.

importHotKeyDescription: Scan your private-key QR or enter your Miden everyday and EVM private keys. Your everyday key finds your Guardian account. The supplied EVM key restores its EVM address; the wallet cannot verify that these keys belong together.
importHotKeyInvalid: Provide both private keys as valid, nonzero 32-byte secp256k1 scalars (64 hexadecimal characters each). QR codes must contain exactly hot-key:evm-key.
evmPrivateKeyMissing: This account's EVM private key is missing. Both keys are required for export. Restore the original EVM key from your backup.
privateKeyPairWarning: Keep both keys secret. Anyone with them can control your Miden and EVM assets. This export does not include your Guardian recovery key.
keyCameraUnavailable: Camera scanning is unavailable here. Upload a QR image or enter both keys manually.
invalidQrImage: Could not read a QR code from this image. Choose a clear QR image up to 20 MB or enter both keys manually.
privateKeyPairReady: Both keys are ready to import.
importHotKeyError: Could not import an account with this key.
importHotKeyWrongScheme: This key uses an unsupported scheme. Paste the everyday key of a Guardian account.
importHotKeyNoAccount: No Guardian account was found for this key at this Guardian.
importHotKeyIsRecoveryKey: This looks like your recovery key. Paste the everyday key instead.
importHotKeyNotActive: This key is no longer active for the account. Paste the current everyday key.
recoveryActionsRequireRecoveryKey: Guardian changes and key replacement need the recovery key, which is not on this device.
unlockPasswordErrorDelay: You have entered the wrong password three times. Your wallet is being blocked for
viewThisInPrivatePlace: View this in a private place
anyoneWithRecoveryPhrase: Anyone who knows your recovery phrase can access your wallet and funds.
pleaseWriteDownRecoveryPhrase: Please write down your secret recovery phrase and keep it in a safe place.
minimalFeeGreaterThanBalanceVerbose: Minimal fee for this transaction is greater than your balance. A large fee may be required because of you sending funds to an empty Manager account. That requires a one-time 0.06425 $gasTokenSymbol$ burn fee;
confirmRisk: I understand the risk and wish to proceed.
seedPhraseDescription: Please write down your secret recovery phrase and keep it in a safe place. This phrase is the only way to recover your account.
doNotShareWithAnyone: Do not share it with anyone.
anyoneCanTakeAssets: Anyone with this phrase can take your assets forever.
noOperationsFound: You don't currently have any transactions.
ifYouWantToRevealPrivateKeyFromOtherAcco: If you want to reveal a view key from another account - you should select it in the top-right dropdown.
privateKeyFieldDescription: Current account key. Keep it in secret.

revealSecretUnlockDescription: Unlock with your passcode to reveal the $secretName$.

proofGenerationTab: An open tab is required to efficiently generate transaction proofs
delegateProofSettingsDescription: When on, transaction proofs are generated on remote servers — faster, with no large download to your device, and your keys never leave it. When off, or if the service is unavailable, the wallet proves locally: more private, but slower and needs a large one-time download.

nothingToPaste: Nothing to paste. Copy an address first.
sendUsdcxOnlyDestination: Only USDCx can be sent to this network.
swapRateNote: The rate is the most the solver fills at right now, with its $fee$ fee already in it. Your receive amount is that rate less your $slippage$ slippage.
swapVerdictSettlementDelayed: Settlement delayed. Your order will wait.
swapVerdictNoPrice: Prices are unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
swapVerdictOffMarket: The price moved. Refresh the quote.
swapVerdictNoLiquidity: Not enough orders at the current price right now.
swapVerdictTolerated: May take longer: fills when the price moves slightly.
swapVerdictPartial: Only part of this order fills now; the rest waits.
swapNoFillWarning: This swap is unlikely to fill with the liquidity available now. You can continue, but your order may remain unfilled until it expires.
swapPartialFillWarning: Only part of this swap can fill with the liquidity available now. You can continue, but the rest may remain unfilled until the order expires.
swapSlippageNote: How far below the current rate your order may fill. On testnet an order above about 0.25% does not fill.
swapSlippageEditedNote: You set the receive amount yourself, so slippage does not apply to this order.
swapSlippageRange: Enter a percent from $min$ to $max$ with up to two decimals.

swapSameToken: Pick two different tokens to swap.

swapPairNotListed: This pair can no longer be swapped. Go back and choose another token.
swapBelowMinimum: Offer at least $1 worth of assets to swap.

swapSuccessTrackProgress: You can track its progress in Activities.

verifySeedPhraseReviewBody: Write down these words in order.
breadWalletDescription: Bread Wallet is a simple and secure way to manage your digital money privately.
chooseImportTypeDescription: Restore public balance with your 12-word phrase. To restore private funds, upload the encrypted backup file.
importWithSeedPhraseDescription: You can use a compatible 12-word recovery phrase from another wallet to create a Miden account. This does not transfer assets from other networks.
importWithEncryptedWalletFileDescription: Upload your encrypted wallet file to securely import your account. Your data remains private, with only hashed information stored on-chain
enterDecryptionPassword: Enter the password you set when exporting your wallet. This will decrypt the file and restore access.
chooseHowToProtect: Choose how you want to protect your wallet
biometricSetupReason: Set up biometric unlock for your wallet
biometricUnavailable: Biometric unlock isn't available on this device.
biometricNotEnrolledWork: Set up Fingerprint or Face Unlock for work in Settings to use it here.
biometricNotEnrolled: Set up a fingerprint or face in Settings to use biometric unlock.
biometricStrongNotEnrolledWork: The face or fingerprint unlock set up for work isn't secure enough to protect a wallet. Set up Fingerprint for work in Settings to use it here.
biometricStrongNotEnrolled: The face or fingerprint unlock set up on this device isn't secure enough to protect a wallet. Set up a fingerprint in Settings to use biometric unlock.
biometricNotStrong: This device's biometrics can't protect a wallet. Use a passcode instead.
biometricHardwareUnavailable: The biometric sensor isn't available right now. Try again, or use a passcode.
biometricUnavailableIOS: Face ID or Touch ID isn't available. If it's turned off for this app, turn it on in Settings, or use a passcode.
biometricSecurityUpdate: Install the latest security update to use biometric unlock.
biometricPasscodeNotSet: Set a device passcode in Settings to use biometric unlock.
biometricLockedOut: Biometric unlock is locked after too many attempts. Unlock your device, then try again.
chooseGuardianDescription: Your Guardian acknowledges every transaction and can help you recover your account.
meetGuardianNoneReachable: No Guardian operator is reachable on this network.
meetGuardianFullyPrivateInstead: I'd rather make a fully private account instead
guardianIntroDescription: A Guardian backs up your private account data and acknowledges your transactions.
guardianIntroRecoverBody: Your recovery phrase restores your keys and, with your Guardian's backup, your account. Keep the phrase safe.
guardianIntroFundsBody: Your Guardian acknowledges your transactions. It can never move funds on its own.
guardianIntroSwitchBody: Move to another Guardian whenever you like. Your account stays the same.
guardianProviderSheetDescription: They all back up your account the same way.
guardianProviderSheetFootnote: You can switch any time in Settings.
guardianAboutOpenZeppelin: OpenZeppelin, a smart contract security company known for its audits.
guardianAboutGateway: Gateway, a blockchain infrastructure provider that runs nodes and networks.
guardianAboutLambdaClass: LambdaClass, an engineering firm that builds zero-knowledge systems.
guardianAboutKodax: Korea Digital Asset, a digital asset custody company based in South Korea.
guardianAboutPara: Para, an embedded wallet infrastructure provider.
guardianInfoDescription: A Guardian is an independent service that acknowledges every transaction from your wallet, adding a safety net without giving up self-custody.
guardianInfoWhatItDoesDescription: Acknowledges every transaction — neither your device nor the Guardian can move funds alone. Helps you recover your account if you lose your device.
guardianInfoWhatItCannotDoDescription: Move your funds on its own. Access your private state. See your balances unless you share them.
guardianInfoSwitchingIsEasyDescription: You can switch to a different Guardian at any time with your recovery phrase. Only who acknowledges your transactions changes; your account and funds stay the same.
verifyMessagePrefix: Confirm you've saved your recovery phrase.
verifyMessageSuffix: Select the first and last words from your phrase
verifyStepSelectFirst: Tap the first word of your recovery phrase
verifyStepSelectLast: Now tap the last word of your recovery phrase
verifyStepCorrect: That's the first and last word — tap Continue
verifyStepWrong: That's not the first and last word — tap them again
recoveryPhraseSevenDayReminder: Write down your recovery phrase within 7 days to fully secure your wallet.
recoveryPhraseDailyReminder: We'll remind you daily on the home screen.
finishRestoringOnOpen: Open your wallet to finish restoring it.
createPasswordDescription: Set a password to unlock your wallet
minimumCharsWithAtLeast: Minimum 8 characters with at least 1 number
backUpWalletInstructions: Save these 12 words and store in a secure place.
seedPhraseRecoveryCaption: Your recovery phrase restores your keys. It is used to rotate your everyday key, not for day-to-day transactions.
resetRequiredDescription: Miden Testnet has upgraded to bech32 account IDs to improve your experience. To keep using your wallet, please restore from a backup file or recovery phrase, or create a new one.
forgotPasswordDescription: If you've forgotten your password, you need to sign out and re-import your account. After that, you can create a new password.
forgotPasswordSecondDescription: Do not sign out unless you know your 12-word recovery phrase or have an encrypted backup file.
biometricUnlockRequiredDescription: This wallet uses biometric authentication only. Use Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode to unlock. To access your wallet on another device, use your 12-word recovery phrase.
guardianSwitchAlreadyInProgress: A Guardian switch is already in progress. Wait for it to finish before starting another.
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedBody: The switch was submitted, but this device couldn't confirm it went through on chain. Nothing in the wallet can confirm it for you — your Guardian settings and this transaction's Activity entry will both name the new Guardian either way. If a later transaction is refused because it couldn't be acknowledged, run the switch again.
guardianSwitchLocalStateNotSavedTitle: Not saved on this device yet.
guardianSwitchLocalStateNotSavedBody: The Guardian switch reached the network, but this device couldn't save your account's new state yet. The wallet keeps trying in the background, and until it succeeds, transactions from this device may not go through. You don't need to run the Guardian switch again.
guardianSwitchLocalStateUnrecoverableBod: The Guardian switch reached the network, but this device couldn't save your account's new state and can't recover it by itself. Don't run the Guardian switch again. Contact support.
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedEndpointNotSave: This device also couldn't save the new Guardian's address, so it still shows the previous one. The wallet will ask you to re-enter it — that prompt won't start another switch.
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedInfo3: Once the switch is confirmed, new transactions need your new Guardian to be reachable before they can complete.
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedInfo1: Once the switch is confirmed on chain, your new Guardian acknowledges every transaction and your old Guardian can no longer acknowledge transactions for your account.
guardianSwitchEndpointNotSavedBody: The switch is confirmed on chain, but this device couldn't save the new Guardian's address. The wallet checks for this automatically and will prompt you to re-enter it if needed — this won't start another switch. If no prompt appears, contact support.
guardianSwitchRegistrationPendingBody: The switch is confirmed on chain. Registering your account with the new Guardian hasn't finished yet — the wallet retries automatically a limited number of times. If it still hasn't finished, contact support.
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo1: Your new Guardian acknowledges every transaction from now on — your old Guardian can no longer acknowledge transactions for your account.
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo2: Your wallet address, funds, and history are unchanged. Nothing moved during the rotation.
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo3: New transactions need your new Guardian to be reachable before they can complete.
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo4: You can rotate your Guardian again at any time — keep your recovery phrase safe, it's required to do so.
guardianSwitchAuthenticationDescription: Authenticate to approve this Guardian switch.
guardianAuthenticationUnavailable: Authentication is unavailable. Try again before switching Guardian.
guardianRotationExplainer: From now on, $newGuardian$ acknowledges your transactions instead of $oldGuardian$. Your address, funds and history stay exactly the same.
oldGuardianCantBlockTitle: Your old Guardian can't block this
oldGuardianCantBlockBody: Rotation is approved by your two on-device keys. The old Guardian is only notified.
replaceHotKeyDescription: Generate a new everyday key and replace the current one on-chain. Useful if you suspect your device is compromised.
replaceHotKeyConfirmation: This is signed with your recovery (cold) key. Your recovery phrase is not required, and your funds and account stay the same. Continue?
replaceHotKeyConfirmationSeedRequired: This is signed with your recovery (cold) key. You will be asked for your recovery phrase to sign it, and your funds and account stay the same. Continue?
hotKeyRotationOverlayBody: Your everyday key is being rotated. This is required when setting up a recovered account so it can sync and make transactions.
hotKeyAddOverlayBody: This device is getting its own everyday key so it can sync and make transactions.
hotKeyRotationFailedGeneric: Something went wrong while rotating your everyday key. Your funds are safe, and you can retry now.
hotKeyRotationStartOverTitle: Remove this wallet and start over?
hotKeyRotationStartOverBody: This removes the wallet from this device so you can restore it again, for example with a different guardian URL. Your funds stay on the network. You will need your recovery phrase to restore the wallet.
hotKeyRotatedOutBody: This account's everyday key was moved to another device, usually by restoring the wallet there. This device cannot use the account until you make it the main device again.
hotKeyRotatedOutBodyNoRecoveryKey: This account's everyday key was moved to another device, usually by restoring the wallet there. This device has no recovery key, so it cannot take the account back. Restore the wallet with your recovery phrase to use it here.
hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMain: Make this device the main one
hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMainTitle: Make this device the main one?
hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMainBody: The wallet rotates the everyday key to this device. The other device loses access to this account and sees this same notice. A small network fee is paid from the account.
chooseDeviceRoleTitle: How should this device join your wallet?
chooseDeviceRoleDescription: This device gets its own everyday key. A small network fee is paid from the account.
chooseDeviceRoleDevices: You already have $count$ devices with this wallet
chooseDeviceRoleDevice: You already have 1 device with this wallet
chooseDeviceRoleMain: Make this device the main one
chooseDeviceRoleMainSubtitle: Every other device is removed from this wallet
keepRecoveryPhraseTitle: Keep the recovery phrase on this device?
keepRecoveryPhraseBody: Daily transactions work without the recovery phrase on this device. Guardian changes and everyday key replacement will ask you to enter it. Write it down before you remove it.
hotKeyRotationUnconfirmedBody: The wallet could not confirm whether the rotation went through. Your funds are safe, though its network fee may have been paid. Give the wallet a minute to sync before you retry.
hotKeyRotationFundingTitle: Add USDCX to activate your everyday key
hotKeyRotationFundingBody: Activating your everyday key is a transaction, and every transaction pays a small network fee in USDCX. Send USDCX to this account's address below. The wallet claims it and finishes activating your key automatically.
hotKeyRotationFundingTooSmall: The USDCX you received is too little to pay the network fee. Send a little more.
hotKeyRotationFundingClaimFailed: The USDCX you received could not be claimed.
hotKeyRotationFundingClaimUnconfirmed: The wallet could not confirm whether the USDCX you received was claimed. Give the wallet a minute to sync before you retry.
guardianChangedBody: Your guardian was switched and we couldn't identify the new operator. Enter its URL to reconnect.
guardianUrlMismatch: That operator doesn't match your account's on-chain guardian.
guardianUrlUnreachable: Couldn't reach that operator. Check the URL and your connection, then try again.
guardianUrlNoOnChainGuardian: This account has no on-chain guardian to verify against yet.
guardianUrlStaleRetry: Your Guardian changed while the address was being checked. Please try again.
connectivityGuardianBody: Your guardian isn't responding, so transactions can't be acknowledged.
revealHotKeyDescription: Your everyday key is rotatable from Settings → Rotate everyday key, so revealing it is lower-stakes than your recovery phrase — but anyone who holds it can sign transactions until you rotate.
hotKeyRevealWarningTitle: Before you reveal your private keys
hotKeyRevealWarningBody: Anyone with these keys can control your Miden and EVM assets. Rotating your Miden everyday key does not change or protect a leaked EVM key.
invalidUrl: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
customGuardianUnreachable: No Guardian answered at this URL. Check it and try again.
encryptedWalletFileDescription: Enter your password to access your Encrypted Wallet File.
encryptedWalletFileDescriptionHardware: Unlock with your passcode to access your Encrypted Wallet File.
encryptedWalletFileConfirmation: I will not share my Encrypted Wallet File with anyone, including Bread.
encryptedWalletFileGuardianTitle: Account state of $accountNames$ is in this file
encryptedWalletFileGuardianDesc: The file holds your recovery phrase and the account state your Guardian operator otherwise keeps for you, so anyone with the file and its password can read both. It holds no everyday key: after restoring, the wallet replaces it through your Guardian operator, or you can use a saved everyday key pair (Settings → Keys → Reveal Private Key). The file is a snapshot: after you send or receive, save a new one, because an older file cannot restore what happened after it.
hotKeyRotationImportBusy: A rotation is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
hotKeyRotationUseKeyPair: Use my saved everyday key pair
encryptedWalletFileExcludedDesc: Guardian accounts imported with private keys cannot be restored from a wallet file, and a wallet restored from this file cannot add them. They are restored as a separate wallet, set up with Import private keys and their Miden everyday and EVM private keys. Keep those keys safe: reveal them in Settings → Keys → Reveal Private Key with that account selected.
enterPasswordToEncrypt: Enter a password to encrypt your wallet file.
encryptedWalletFileReadFailed: The wallet file could not be read. Choose it again.
encryptedWalletFileSelectOne: Choose a wallet file to continue.

helpImproveWalletDescription: Shares which parts of Wallet you use, where you get stuck, broad error categories, the app version, and your platform, so we can fix what's breaking. Never your keys, recovery phrase, password, addresses, balances, amounts, or transaction contents. No tracking across other apps or sites, nothing used for advertising, and nothing sold or shared with data brokers. Crash reports are sent either way: the error and where it happened in the code, scrubbed to remove sensitive data, with no identifier for you or your device. You can change this any time.
